text:
Subject: Heater out in Apartment 4B since October 2

Dear Ms. Alvarez,

The heater in Apartment 4B stopped working on October 2. I reported it by phone on October 3 and have not had a response.

Overnight temperatures are now in the 40s °F, and the apartment gets cold enough that it is hard to sleep. Section 12 of our lease requires the landlord to provide heat.

Please have the heater repaired within 48 hours of this email. If you or a technician need access, tell me which times work and I will make sure someone can let them in.

Please confirm by reply when a repair visit is scheduled.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
Apartment 4B
